use_case: A customer-support assistant follows a stable escalation policy while answering from frequently updated product documentation.
A developer portal assistant must cite the latest SDK reference and consistently produce tested migration checklists.
expected_reasoning_points: format and troubleshooting patterns should remain consistent

use_case: An analyst assistant explains a firm's approved valuation methodology using stable internal examples without accessing live market data.
A legal information assistant answers only from the latest approved policies and must quote citations without giving legal advice.
A healthcare intake assistant follows clinic language, checks deterministic red-flag rules, and requests clinician approval before scheduling.
Employees ask questions about frequently revised internal benefits and require links to the governing source.
expected_reasoning_points: specialized model behaviour is not established

use_case: A shopping assistant answers questions about prices that change several times per day.
expected_reasoning_points: prices must not be learned through alignment

use_case: A banking assistant retrieves the signed-in user's balance and recent transactions while enforcing account permissions.
An operations assistant drafts a refund and can issue it only after an employee approves the exact amount.
expected_reasoning_points: external action requires a controlled tool
approval cannot be delegated to model text

use_case: A developer assistant diagnoses build failures using stable company debugging playbooks and live CI logs.
An API classifies incoming messages into a fixed taxonomy using hundreds of reviewed examples and a strict JSON format.
expected_reasoning_points: repeated stable decision pattern suits alignment

use_case: A team wants a specialist assistant but only has a two-paragraph marketing page and no examples of acceptable answers.
Two policy manuals disagree about escalation thresholds and neither has an owner or effective date.
expected_runtime_scope: resolved authoritative policy after governance review
expected_reasoning_points: resolve authority and versioning before automation

use_case: An assistant recommends whether to approve a high-value loan using current account data and regulated decision rules.
expected_reasoning_points: model must not make final approval

use_case: A casual writing assistant rewrites general meeting notes for clarity with no specialist vocabulary or compliance requirements.
expected_reasoning_points: alignment would add cost without a defined benefit
